title: Naturality of the prescribed common-stage right unitor
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X with l invertible, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l. In the category C with tensor T of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], let U and r be the reconstructed common-stage unit and prescribed right unitor of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-constraints]. For every arrow f:K to Kprime, T(f,id_U) followed by r(Kprime) equals r(K) followed by f.

proof.text: Form the natural tensor-reduction comparison from the normalized integral tensor model and the reduction/limit counit. Apply faithful coherent reduction to the integral right-unitor square, and substitute the defining reduction equations for the two unitors. Functoriality moves the coefficient-unit comparison past the first-variable arrow; Mathlib right-unitor naturality in the coherent system monoidal category proves the reduced square. Faithfulness proves the integral square.

Use the rational tensor specification, including its bilinear Hom map and pure-tensor normalization, and the localized integral right-unitor specification. Induct on a rational arrow as a sum of pure scalar tensors. On each pure tensor, the two compositions are scalar tensors of the integral naturality equation; zero and sums follow from linearity and bilinearity of composition.

Choose a representative of the arrow at a stage containing the tensor objects of both endpoints with the common unit. Represent the unit identity there as well. Substitute the prescribed common-stage tensor and right-unitor formulas, using their object equalities to handle their heterogeneous equations. Composition of representative classes is composition at this stage. Cancel the intermediate tensor comparison and commute the unit comparison past the first-variable arrow using tensor functoriality. Rational naturality makes the stage representatives equal, hence their common-stage classes equal. No separate tower calculation is needed because the given representative specifications hold at every sufficiently large stage.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageTensorRightUnitor_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {K K' : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X} (f : K ⟶ K') :
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X).map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l Ω X K').hom =
      (pullbackTensorCommonRightUnitor l Ω X K).hom ≫ f
